title: laothoe pomeridiana
intro: Laothoe pomeridiana, commonly known as the Asian swallowtail flower or Queen of the Night, is a flowering plant native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which may help alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Laothoe pomeridiana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
